reason: I don't look for events, they find me through stories and friends reposting. I'm not going to open a separate app to browse a feed when my feed already shows me what my people are doing.
objection: Another app that wants my location and notifications, and none of my friends are on it yet. If nobody I know is going, a list of events with dates means nothing to me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app's events reposted in my friends' Instagram stories with people I actually know marked as going — if the group starts organizing through it, I'd follow them in.
